provider: Borealis (Canadian Dataverse Repository, University of Toronto / Scholars Portal)

free_tier.stated: No quota object. Not a policy number either — nothing published. 24,727 datasets across 1,858 collections, all unmetered by the platform.

egress.terms: Cloudflare-fronted; answered the version API in 0.77 s, the fastest of the six majors tested.

tooling: curl against /api/; same client code as Harvard
chaining: Best combination: no quota object AND a working native email signup AND the largest live dataset base outside Harvard. A single account is not byte-bounded by any number the service can report.
limits_note: No per-file or per-account figure published; no quota endpoint returns a number. Platform default applies (unlimited unless :MaxFileUploadSizeInBytes is set).
reliability_note: Scheduled upgrade to 6.12.1 with 7h downtime announced on the signup page itself — reads may be affected during maintenance windows.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, form served; fields dataverseUserForm:accountInfoView:{email,affiliation,userName,password}; none carry a required or aria-required attribute
'Users who wish to create collections and/or datasets and upload data and metadata must have a user acco...' (account required, no affiliation stated)
